title: Use an example for an exact pattern
summary: An example can show the desired style or mapping. This is often called few-shot prompting when several examples are provided.
introduction: An example can show the desired style or mapping. This is often called few-shot prompting when several examples are provided. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use an example for an exact pattern
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An example can show the desired style or mapping. This is often called few-shot prompting when several examples are provided.

blocks.code:
Task: label a number as even or odd.
Example: 2 -> even
Example: 3 -> odd
Now label: 8
blocks.title: Use an example for an exact pattern

blocks.text: The examples show the output labels. The expected answer is even because 8 divides into pairs with no remainder.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add 0 as a test case and state the expected label.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Examples must be correct; a wrong example can teach the wrong pattern.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
